draft.emotion: furrowing the brow and sighing softly over a tangled puzzle
notes: Opposite of 'dễ' (easy). Can be placed directly before a verb to mean 'hard to do something' (e.g. 'khó hiểu' – hard to understand).
To describe a person who is hard to please, use 'khó tính'; for financial hardship, use 'khó khăn'.
